observations.title: Weak trend structure (4/7 trend-template checks)
observations.detail: Missing: 150-day above 200-day; 200-day average rising vs a month ago; 50-day above the 150- and 200-day. Leaders in a Stage 2 uptrend typically meet all seven; stocks failing several are rarely where the strongest moves start.

observations.title: Extended: 29% above the 50-day average
observations.detail: Stocks stretched this far above their average often pull back or consolidate; buying here means a wider gap to the nearest support.

observations.title: Heavy-volume selloff on 2026-11-05 (-2.9% on 1.7x volume)
observations.detail: Large down days on high volume are how institutions leave; watch whether the stock recovers the day's range.

observations.title: Accumulation: up-day volume is 2.1x down-day volume (50 sessions)
observations.detail: More shares change hands on advances than declines.

observations.title: RSI 71: overbought zone
observations.detail: In strong uptrends RSI can stay above 70 for weeks, so it is not a sell signal by itself; it does mean new buys are chasing strength.

levels.label: 52-week high
levels.note: A close above it on volume above 13.8M shares (1.4x the 50-day average) is the classic breakout confirmation.

levels.label: 20-day high
levels.note: Short-term resistance from the recent swing high.

levels.label: 7-8% below today's close
levels.note: O'Neil's rule of thumb is to cut losses 7-8% below the purchase price. Shown from today's close (19.03 to 19.23) for scale only.

levels.label: 2 x ATR below today's close
levels.note: ATR(14) is 0.76; two ATRs is a common volatility-based distance for judging noise vs a real move.

levels.label: 21-day average
levels.note: First support in strong uptrends; leaders often bounce here.

levels.label: 200-day average
levels.note: Long-term trend line; losing it often marks the end of a Stage 2 uptrend.

levels.label: 50-day average
levels.note: Key support for leaders; a close below on heavy volume is a warning.
